posts.title: Why "Build vs Buy" is the Wrong Question
posts.description: In big, enterprise IT departments, the question of build vs buy will often come up. A well-intentioned leader will challenge a group: Do we really want our talented (and expensive) engineers building this thing? posts.title: The weight of AI on engineers
posts.description: Accountability has a weight limit If the AI deletes all your business-critical data, you can't fire the AI . If an AI controlled missile launcher accidentally shoots an ally, you can't send the AI to prison. AI can act, but only humans can be accountable .
